rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF THE SPREAD OF THE HUMAN IMMUNODEFICIENC Y VIRUS (HIV) AND ACQUIRED IMMUNE DEFICIENCY SYNDROME (AIDS), PRESCRIBING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "AIDS Control Act of 1993" Provides   for the  creation of PREVENTION AND CONTROL DIVISION in the Dept.  of Health; prescribes the powers and duties of  the Division. Provides, likewise, for   these related concerns: (1) information dissemination campaign on AIDS;  (2) regulation  on the  issuance of working permits  to hospitality girls;   (3) establishment of  a Central AIDS Registry;  (4) regulation of blood banks; and (5) penalties  for violation of the provisions of this Act.  * * *
